about: Reference ranges a composed night is benchmarked against (packages/core/src/benchmark.ts). Drawn from docs/reviews/benchmark-reference-sets.md, 'Common patterns' (11 published sets A–K plus DJ statements). Small sample: ranges, not targets.

darienzo.label: D'Arienzo tandas per 4 h
darienzo.source: Common patterns §1: golden-only nights A, C, D, I run 3–4 per 4 h; all 11 sets 0–3.8 (median 1.3)

orchestras.label: Distinct orchestras
orchestras.source: Common patterns §2: median 14, range ~12–19 per night (~4 h), scaled by the night's hours

vals.label: Vals share of dance tandas
vals.source: Common patterns §3: vals 6–19 % across the 11 sets (median 15 %)

milonga.label: Milonga share of dance tandas
milonga.source: Common patterns §3: milonga 4–24 % across the 11 sets (median 14 %)

pugliese.label: Pugliese: once per 4 h, late
pugliese.source: Common patterns §4: in 7 of 11 sets, always exactly once, positions 0.48–1.0 (median 0.89)

cumparsita.label: La Cumparsita closes
cumparsita.source: Common patterns §5: Cumparsita closes 7 of 8 sets with an observable ending (88 %)

canon.label: Core canon present
canon.source: Common patterns §6: Di Sarli and Biagi 11/11, D'Arienzo and Donato 10/11 sets

golden.label: Golden-era coverage (1935–45)
golden.source: Common patterns §6: the great majority of tandas in A, B, C, D, I and K fall in 1935–45

instrumental.label: Instrumental tandas each hour
instrumental.source: Victor Tran, Tango DJ Fundamentals Part 2: at least one third of tandas each hour should be instrumental. 'Near' down to 15 %: the published sets themselves run about 10–35 % instrumental (A 4 + 3 mixed of 26, B 2 + 3 of 20, C 3 + 5 of 23)

spacing3.label: No orchestra or singer twice in 3 tandas
spacing3.source: Victor Tran, Tango DJ Fundamentals Part 2: no orchestra or singer in more than one of any 3 consecutive tandas

cycle.label: TTVTTM cycle
cycle.source: Common patterns §3: TTVTTM explicit in A, B, C, D, G and Demirbaş (Turkey); Victor Tran: a ~1 h cycle

sizes.label: Vals and milonga tandas of 3
sizes.source: Common patterns §3: vals and milonga tandas have 3 songs in every set

cortinaLength.label: Cortina length
cortinaLength.source: Demirbaş 2018 (Turkish DJs): cortinas at least 30 s and at most 1–1.5 min; Set K 31–33 s excerpts

cortinaCulture.label: Cortina culture
cortinaCulture.note: Turkish-linked published sets use international cortinas (pop, soul, swing, hip-hop); Turkish songs appear as accents. An all-Turkish cortina night is a stylistic choice with no published precedent, not a failure.
cortinaCulture.source: Common patterns §7 and the Turkish-linked sets H, J, K; Demirbaş 2018

yearSpread.label: Tanda year spread
yearSpread.source: Round 13 cohesion review §4.2: benchmark-reference-sets.md A–D single-family tandas median 1 y, 81 % ≤ 2 y, 96 % ≤ 4 y (n = 57); 31-set corpus median 2 y, 67 % ≤ 2 y

goldenCore.label: Golden core share (family core bands)
goldenCore.source: Round 13 golden-age purist review: family bands §2 (orchestra_profiles.json goldenBands); reference sets A–K centre on 1938–44

transitions.label: Transition smoothness (pairwise S between consecutive tandas)
transitions.source: Round 13 transitions review §2 and §4; structural sub-score (style + era + tempo + vocal + run) over the 30 reference sets with ≥ 10 tandas: mean 89.5, p25 87.2, p75 91.3; no reference set has two dramatic tandas adjacent
transitions.credit: clamp((meanS − 80) / 8, 0, 1) × (1 − 0.2 · max(0, jarring − maxJarringPer4h)), × 0.5 for any H1 or H6 hit (transitions review §4)

heatmapBest.label: Heatmap best years (sides from grade ≥ 3 years)
heatmapBest.source: The user's own orchestra heatmap (data/sources/All_orchestras.xls → data/index/coverage.json): per orchestra, year and mode, 3 good / 4 fantastic; round-13 best-years review §1.0
